evaluator.name: Deterministic validators plus primary-agent cross-source review

contractChecks.evidence: Only Notion, Linear, Stripe, ElevenLabs, and Ramp were studied, all at deep depth.
Every report uses official public sources, evidence IDs, confidence, and explicit limitations.
All five qualified runs contain five page categories and desktop, laptop, and mobile observations.
All raw packages pass 100/100 and all sanitised exports validate without raw media or source-repository access.
Source signatures are excluded and Mez ideas remain unapproved hypotheses derived across sources or direct Mez needs.
The human-selected panel is software-centred and omits standalone design-system, cross-category, and dedicated anti-reference research.

qualityDimensions.evidence: Each source has a deep memo plus five-page responsive capture.
All reports share observation, mechanism, convention, transfer, exclusion, limitation, and hypothesis layers.
Raw runs, source URLs, evidence IDs, validation, export checksums, and failures are recorded.
No source values, assets, screenshots, copy, or signature combination is promoted into Mez.
The five sources are strong software references but provide intentionally narrow category range.
Structural experiments are ready. H2 visual direction is correctly deferred until the experiments are built.

notes: The deep-source cycle is complete. The warning is a recorded panel limitation, not a request to add unapproved sources.
